definition_quote.value: Persons who diagnose, prescribe, or prescribe and furnish medicine for ailments of the human foot, or treat such ailments by medical, mechanical, or surgical treatments.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Human foot" means the ankle and soft tissue which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: A license to practice podiatry shall not authorize the licensee to amputate the human foot.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A licensed podiatric physician may do all of the following: a. Administer local anesthesia. b. Administer conscious sedation in a hospital or an ambulatory surgical center.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: Any board created under this chapter that licenses a prescribing practitioner shall adopt rules under chapter 17A establishing penalties for prescribing practitioners that prescribe opioids in dosage amounts exceeding what would be prescribed by a reasonably prudent prescribing practitioner engaged in the same practice.
